note: TASK-095 B6: is the freeze attached to the LOADED scene's canvas items (vs runtime-created ones)? Sample a pixel that only Background covers, change the loaded Background, then cover the same pixel with a runtime-created ColorRect, then force-redraw the loaded item.

var r = get_viewport().get_texture().get_image()
return "P1(10,580)=" + str(r.get_pixel(10, 580)) + " P2(400,580)=" + str(r.get_pixel(400, 580)) + " bg=" + str(get_parent().get_node("Background").color)

var c = ColorRect.new()
c.name = StringName("C9")
c.size = Vector2(800, 600)
c.position = Vector2(0, 0)
c.color = Color(1, 1, 0, 1)
get_parent().add_child(c)
return "C9 added " + str(c.get_path())

var r = get_viewport().get_texture().get_image()
return "P1(10,580)=" + str(r.get_pixel(10, 580)) + " P2(400,580)=" + str(r.get_pixel(400, 580)) + " C9=" + str(get_parent().get_node("C9").color)

get_parent().get_node("C9").queue_free()
var bg = get_parent().get_node("Background")
bg.color = Color(0, 1, 0, 1)
bg.queue_redraw()
bg.hide()
bg.show()
bg.size = Vector2(800, 600)
return "forced: bg=" + str(bg.color) + " visible=" + str(bg.visible) + " size=" + str(bg.size)
